text: rasaṃ sāyitvā . kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā . manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme adhimuccati appiyarūpe [3] dhamme byāpajjati anupaṭṭhitāya satiyāva viharati parittacetaso tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti . evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa aguttadvāro hotīti . [208] acchariyaṃ bho kaccāna abbhūtaṃ bho kaccāna yāvañcidaṃ #1 ma. yu. māṇavakehi . 2 ma. anupaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati . evamuparipi . #3 ma. ca . bhotā kaccānena aguttadvārova samāno aguttadvāroti akkhāto . guttadvāroti bhavaṃ kaccāno
